source.attribution: DAVIS: Perazzi et al., CVPR 2016; Pont-Tuset et al., 2017. MP4 conversion: emirkisa.
source.reference_note: Decoded MP4 mirror, letterboxed and sampled every second frame; not camera RAW.

metric_notes: PSNR from pooled MSE; Infinity string means exact match. SSIM is mean local RGB SSIM; masked SSIM includes neighborhoods outside mask. Temporal error = mean absolute error in consecutive-frame differences / 255. Missing corrupted frames use zero placeholders for metric penalty only.
